name: two nested steps, without a spec title, are both kept

endpoints.title: Verify identity
endpoints.description: Submit identity verification details. Only the fields relevant to the account type chosen in the previous step apply -- OpenAPI has no clean way to express "required only if accountType is X," so every field here is optional at the schema level; the adaptive step engine narrows this down to the right subset at runtime.

fields.name: dateOfBirth
fields.label: Date Of Birth
fields.description: Individual accounts only. The account owner's date of birth.

fields.name: governmentIdNumber
fields.label: Government Id Number
fields.description: Individual accounts only. A government-issued identification number.

fields.name: residentialAddress
fields.label: Residential Address
fields.description: Individual accounts only. The account owner's residential address.

fields.name: legalBusinessName
fields.label: Legal Business Name
fields.description: Business accounts only. The registered legal name of the business.

fields.name: taxIdNumber
fields.label: Tax Id Number
fields.description: Business accounts only. The business's tax identification number.

fields.name: businessRegistrationNumber
fields.label: Business Registration Number
fields.description: Business accounts only. The business's registration number.

fields.name: businessAddress
fields.label: Business Address
fields.description: Business accounts only. The business's registered address.

fields.name: industryCategory
fields.label: Industry Category
fields.description: Business accounts only. The industry the business operates in.

endpoints.title: Add payout method
endpoints.description: Add a bank account to receive payouts.

fields.name: accountHolderName
fields.label: Account Holder Name
fields.description: The name on the bank account. Should plausibly match the account owner's full name (for an individual account) or legal business name (for a business account) already collected earlier in this flow -- flag it if it looks inconsistent.

fields.name: payoutAccountType
fields.label: Payout Account Type
fields.description: The type of bank account payouts will be sent to.
